correctness.rationale: Constructive positive-block ordering lemma with cases k=1,2,3 and k>=4 realizes every trace of a spanning path; the isolated extra vertex closes it into a cycle. The n−1 upper obstruction is forced by a nearly complete Hamiltonian path. Exact finite enumeration through n=6 and a 31-internal-node/32-leaf depth-five witness prove K6 Ldim=5; 60<64 rules out depth six. Product additivity is justified by independent VC traces and optimal per-component online mistake bounds. The code checks witness cycles and full binary histories.
